goal: An always-on AI agent team that takes work from several projects in Jira and GitHub and drafts it through PO, BA, Tech Lead, Dev, QA Lead, QA and PM roles, with a human in each role approving before anything is written back
description: Each work item flows through role stages with human approval gates; agents run daily on GitHub Actions; per-project config adds a project without code changes; PM watches all projects.
tasks: Poll Jira projects and GitHub repositories for items labelled agent
Draft acceptance criteria, business rules and open questions as BA
Prioritise backlog and draft outcome goals as PO
Draft technical approach and risks and review pull requests as Tech Lead
Write code test-first and open a pull request as Dev
Draft test plans mapped to every acceptance criterion as QA Lead
Write test cases, run tests and retests, and draft results as QA
Summarise status, flag stale or late work and draft release plans across projects as PM
Send each draft to the human approver and wait for passed before writing back
Estimate work size jointly across roles
integration_requirements: Jira REST API read and drafted write-back
GitHub API through a GitHub App
Google Sheets for QA test cases
